description: EVA suit backpack battery trickle chargers: two of three were inoperative on arrival. Almost all comms earpiece/mic units had failed. Strap buckles were incorrectly installed and helmet latches required excessive force or did not latch.
response: Two Engineers spent Sols 1-2 on suit rehabilitation. Only two suits were fully operational for the first EVA.
lesson: Suit audit is a Day 1 priority. Pre-mission: source replacement chargers matched to backpack model, spare comms units, and confirm a sewing machine is present with compatible needles.
pattern_tag: suit hardware failure after winter storage
